mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Multiple BMW builders report King STDX thrust bearings measuring over 1mm too narrow to fit S85 and S65 blocks. Dimensional defect reported by more than one person, titled flatly as defective.

mentions.title: King Bearings?
mentions.snippet: Builder reports a 2024 King main bearing out of spec on free spread, and says a 2025 main was also bad, pointing at an ongoing manufacturing process issue rather than a one-off.
mentions.replyNote: No official King Bearings response found in the thread; not locked, resolved, or deleted.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Customer received a sealed XP series main and rod set with wrong quantities (8 x .011 uppers, 7 x .011 lowers, 1 x .030 lower) and says King refused to supply the missing shell, referring them back to the supplier. Complaint is about service as much as product.

mentions.title: King Bearing Failures?
mentions.snippet: Thread on King main and rod bearings failing during initial startup and break-in of a high-compression engine. Other posters suggest contributing factors beyond the bearing itself.

mentions.title: king Main&Rod Bearings?
mentions.snippet: Discussion including a report of spun rod bearings twice in three months on a boosted setup running King bearings. Single builder, install and clearance not ruled out.
